scope: Four original SDK sample payloads replayed without source-byte patches; two game builds and two developer demos. Neither distinct raw hashes nor developer demos increase the catalog game count.

samples.name: HellfireGNEX
samples.classification: SDK build of existing Hellfire game; same 50 resources and variable data as catalog hellfire.
samples.profileProvenance: Selected SDK2.12 default Samsung SCH-E200 profile: Emulator.ini DefaultVendor/DefaultModel plus SCH_E200.ini PhoneInfo Width/Height. All four sample source headers declare LCDCLASS255 (all displays); .gnx project files do not specify a unique handset. This choice is not proof of real E200 execution.

inputVsEqualTimeIdle.name: HellfireGNEX
inputVsEqualTimeIdle.behaviorFromOriginalSource: Source EVENT_KEYPRESS HE_RUN: key1 moves ship up by6; timer redraws.
